editorial:
Imagine being a huge art lover who just cannot paint to save their life. That is where you find the main character in this crime flick. After a desperate move to steal a painting from a local museum, you get swept up into a massive world of professional thieves and high-stakes heists. It feels like a wild ride from the start, mixing a bit of humor with the stress of trying not to get caught. You will find yourself rooting for the underdog even though he is totally out of his league in the world of professional art crime.

The acting is solid and keeps the story moving along quickly without any boring parts. While some of the plot twists are a bit easy to guess, the energy stays high enough that you won't mind. If you love stories about clever scams and fancy art, you should definitely give this a go. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see the artwork clearly, or you could rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the end, you discover that the artist was being played by the real professionals all along. The big twist reveals that the painting he stole was actually a fake, used as a distraction for a much larger theft. After a tense standoff with the police and the criminals, he manages to escape with a small fortune but loses the art. He ends up finding peace with his lack of talent and starts a new life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heist movies and underdog stories.
